history.sg_progress: The Department of Operational Support has instructed missions to conduct performance reviews on a timely basis. Furthermore, the implementation of the electronic rations management system has allowed missions to perform this task in a timely manner. Further enhancements of that system regarding warehousing and quality control are in progress. UNAMID stands ready to provide any support in the review process while noting that, since the Operation is expected to close down sites within the first six months of 2021, it will be able to provide this support only to the extent that it continues to exist and the relevant staff remain on board. In addition, the Operation notes that it has instituted requisite controls and contract evaluation measures with regard to its rations contractor.
